correctness.rationale: The singleton Möbius faces give the exact 1/t tail. Because rho_12=0, the (1,2) face is an independent two-Pareto convolution and contributes exactly 2 w_1 w_2 log(t)/t^2+O(t^-2). For each strictly negative Gaussian pair, simultaneous lower-tail extremes have exponent 2/(1+rho)>2; after separating the fixed-width boundary strips, conditional Gaussian tails give an integrable dominated-convergence bound on the cooperative core, so the whole pair face is O(t^-2). On the trivariate lower corner, R is a Stieltjes matrix, hence R^{-1} is entrywise nonnegative with diagonal at least one; for nonnegative Gaussian quantiles the copula density is therefore bounded, and the three-face reciprocal integral is O(t^-2). If one p-value is outside that corner, its reciprocal score is bounded and the triple increment is supported in fixed-width singleton/pair shells, also O(t^-2). Summing the faces yields the claimed expansion. Direct tail inversion gives the stated quantile shift and size correction. A fresh sanity check verified positive definiteness/inverse positivity for a representative mixed matrix and the coefficient subtraction; the infinite asymptotic proof is analytic.
residual_risks: The argument is pointwise for fixed correlations; it does not provide a uniform transition theorem as negative correlations approach zero.
The theorem is trivariate with exactly one zero edge and two negative edges.
